role: District Representative · Zamboanga del Sur, 2nd District
profileLabel: Near-neutral economics (low confidence, co-authored); no other dimension scored
summary: Zamboanga del Sur 2nd District representative with 45 principal-authored bills. Authored the right-to-information bill (HB09397) and an additional Regional Trial Court branch. Co-authored estate tax amnesty, fuel excise suspension, plastic-bag excise, general tax amnesty, income-tax restructuring, travel-tax abolition and a ban on passing system losses to consumers.
caveat: All economic evidence is co-authored and mostly direction-neutral tax relief. Right-to-information is a single issue, so democratic institutions is not scored.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Co-authored tax relief and amnesty measures (0, direction-neutral) and a ban on passing system losses to consumers (-1). Two issues, co-authored only.
